Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. City Region is the City Region of Banjar.
2. City Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of the Regional Government administrator who leads the implementation of governmental affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Banjar.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of Regional Government administration.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government that is the authority of the region.
6. Protection of women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
7. Protection of children is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, as well as receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Woman is a person who is female by sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
9. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child who is still in the womb. 10. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence that occurs within the Regional territory.
11. Violence is any act against women and children that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion or deprivation of freedom unlawfully.
12. Empowerment of women is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to strive and work independently after being recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
13. Gender is a concept that refers to the roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural circumstances of society.
14. Social rehabilitation is recovery from disturbances to physical, psychological and social conditions in order to be able to carry out their roles normally again both in the family and in society.
15. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with their families and communities.
16. Assistance is an activity to provide counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims carried out by a person or representative from an institution that has expertise.
17. Prevention is the effort of the government together with families and communities as well as the private sector and/or business world to prevent the occurrence of violence through socialization, education, advocacy and promotion activities.
18. Handling is action taken as soon as possible to the victim when seeing, hearing, and knowing that violence against the victim will, is and/or has occurred.
19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy, and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in a direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.
21. Integrated Service Center for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a technical implementing unit of the Regional Apparatus that carries out technical operational activities and/or technical support activities for integrated services for women and children victims of violence.
22. Forum for the Protection of Victims of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK is a coordination forum for prevention, handling and empowerment of victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner and is formed at the Regional, sub-district, and village levels.
